description: Physical-OOM-gated single-Spark canary for the exact Poolside Laguna S 2.1 NVFP4 checkpoint 07614121 (71.9 GB, FP8 KV cache scheme, 262,144 positions; the 99.7 GB 826aacdf export cannot fit one Spark beside its 8 GB overhead). It preserves the OpenAI reasoning and tool surface while bounding the FP8 KV cache to 3 GB, one sequence, 32K context, 4K chunked prefills, and eager execution. The 126 GB admission envelope is a conservative canary hypothesis, not measured acceptance; retain the original 65K profile and use Laguna XS as the default fleet-fit alternative until this exact variant passes physical startup, memory, and output checks. GB10 memory correction: GPU utilization 0.90 → 0.85 (previously implicit). Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint. This deviates from the upstream memory profile to avoid unified-memory thrashing; context, the explicit KV-cache byte limit and other kit flags are retained; the GPU utilization budget is reduced.
title: Laguna S 2.1 NVFP4 vLLM 32K low-memory canary single Spark
